question: Given correct or explicitly corrupted synthetic depth/scale, support-surface and boundary evidence, does GeometryR2Reducer deterministically close to correct clearance intervals and tri-state assistive geometry while degrading ambiguity to UNKNOWN rather than inventing OCCUPIED?

data_partitions.identity_basis: Exact fixture bytes and expected state maps frozen before the formal canary outcome.

a0_collapse_counterexamples: side obstacles with open center corridor
scale bias insufficient to prove blocked

reducer_contract.name: GeometryR2Reducer
reducer_contract.clear_rule: Emit CLEAR_OBSERVED only when no admissible obstacle interval can occupy the band within the horizon.
reducer_contract.occupied_rule: Emit OCCUPIED_OBSERVED only when the lower evidence bound passes threshold, lateral overlap is guaranteed and the upper forward-distance bound lies within the horizon.
reducer_contract.unknown_rule: Emit UNKNOWN for missing or invalid global geometry, missing local factors, incomplete boundary coverage, or any possible-but-not-guaranteed occupancy interval.
reducer_contract.anti_a0_invariant: Without sufficient positive occupancy evidence, uncertainty may not produce OCCUPIED_OBSERVED.
reducer_contract.unknown_monotonicity: As any frozen uncertainty factor is worsened, each definite state may remain equal or degrade to UNKNOWN; CLEAR_OBSERVED may never become OCCUPIED_OBSERVED due only to uncertainty.

reducer_profile.provenance: Synthetic reducer mechanics constants only; these are not F1 or F2 task-performance gates and may not be copied as such.

pass_rule: All ten gates pass conjunctively. Undefined, absent or mismatched evidence fails; no scalar score, threshold relaxation or partial pass exists.

terminals.kill_effect: Close geometry_r2_interval_reducer_f0_v1 only; do not train, tune task gates or reinterpret B1-A0.

frozen_now: fixture bytes and analytic expected states

unique_successor.scope: A PASS may authorize writing and freezing a separate F1 TRAIN-only protocol. It does not authorize data materialization, model initialization, training or outcome access.

constraints.description: F0 consumes only frozen synthetic factor fixtures; no RGB model, real dataset, B1 artifact outcome or learned parameter enters the canary.
Missing or ambiguous evidence becomes UNKNOWN and is never counted or serialized as occupied.
constraints.rationale: Directly falsifies the A0-like mechanism in which conservatism collapses to universal blocking.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome tri-state semantics and analytic interval inclusion.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Frozen low, medium and high uncertainty ladders for depth, scale, support and boundary factors.
constraints.revision_policy: Any failure kills this reducer version; the outcome may not be rescued in place.

constraints.description: OCCUPIED_OBSERVED requires guaranteed spatial overlap and a positive lower evidence bound; uncertainty alone cannot create occupancy.
constraints.rationale: Prevents an all-blocked operating point from masquerading as safety conservatism.
constraints.calibration_source: Analytic factor truth fixed before execution.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Nine frozen anti-collapse counterexamples span missing, weak, blurred, biased and far evidence.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold adjustment after execution; a new reducer version requires a new frozen fixture protocol.

constraints.description: F0 PASS grants only protocol-writing authority for F1 and never grants F1 execution authority.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Replay 23 analytic factor frames through the SHA-bound reducer and require exact oracle states, deterministic replay, uncertainty monotonicity and absence of unsupported occupancy.
experiment_design.resource_budget: CPU-only execution of 23 synthetic frames and focused unit tests; zero training, model, real-data, teacher, temporal, mobile or device budget.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop and kill this reducer implementation version on the first conjunctive gate failure; do not tune in place after outcome access.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Analytic interval propagation can separate proved obstacle occupancy from missing or threshold-straddling evidence, allowing ambiguity to remain UNKNOWN.
hypotheses.causal_difference: The learned graph is absent; final geometry is produced exclusively by a deterministic interval reducer from oracle or explicitly corrupted continuous factors.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether the R2 geometry definition itself is coherent before any factor model or real dataset is introduced.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Exact replay of frozen depth, scale, support, boundary, orientation and anti-A0 counterexamples.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Ten conjunctive Boolean gates over exact state maps, output coverage, deterministic replay, horizon nesting, uncertainty monotonicity and unsupported occupancy absence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any exact mismatch, learned-task shortcut acceptance, nondeterminism, CLEAR-to-OCCUPIED uncertainty transition, or OCCUPIED without sufficient positive evidence.
hypotheses.resource_budget: One reducer version, one fixture suite, 23 frames, no search.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Kill geometry_r2_interval_reducer_f0_v1 without training or real-data consumption if any gate fails.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It directly tests the mathematical front door that must hold before factor learnability can be scientifically meaningful.

successor_policy.successor_scope: F0 PASS may authorize protocol writing only; F1 execution remains unauthorized.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic, deterministic factor-to-geometry reducer mechanics under 23 frozen analytic cases only. No visual factor learnability, real-scene task utility, teacher, temporal, mobile, Calibration, Confirmation, deployment, product or safety authority.
